name: Corn/Soybean Ratio, Regime & Roll Yield Prediction
description: Corn/soybean ratio dashboard extended with backwardation vs contango regime analysis for ZC and ZS. Shows regime frequency by year, carry time series with shaded backwardation bands, and a scatter of current carry vs forward 63-day carry to test whether today's regime predicts next quarter's roll yield. Uses NoAdjustment for ratio integrity and futures_continuation carry for term structure. Adds high-carry backwardation filter (ZC carry > 5%) with 63-day forward price return analysis to show what next-quarter returns look like when corn is in strong backwardation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN/SOYBEAN RATIO & TERM STRUCTURE DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================
#
# FIX 1 (BUG-5): NoAdjustment for ratio computation
#   BackwardPanamaCanal shifts historical prices by cumulative additive gaps
#   at each roll. Corn (backwardation) and soybeans (contango) accumulate
#   different shifts — destroys ratio over long histories (min=0.053).
#   NoAdjustment preserves real price levels for cross-commodity analysis.
#
# FIX 2 (BUG-7): Built-in carry + spread for term structure
#   Named contract months (ZCN26, ZCZ26) are not supported.
#   cont.carry = front/back - 1 (positive=backwardation, negative=contango)
#   cont.spread = M1 - M2 via spread_depth=1
#
# FIX 3: ZS piped through futures_continuation(NoAdjustment)
#   reference_futures(ticker='ZS') returns raw multi-contract data (all contracts
#   per date as List columns). Downstream transforms resolve via keep_last which
#   picks the last contract in the list — NOT a proper front-month continuation.
#   Fix: pipe ZS reference data through futures_continuation to get proper close.
#
# QUALITY: summary_table uses AggType.Max/Min/Last — period-agnostic.
#   Run for 3Y → get 3Y high/low. Run for 10Y → get 10Y high/low.
#   ColumnSpec.title is ignored for summary_table (not on SummaryCellDef proto).
#   Use info= for per-cell tooltips, row_headers/col_headers for labels.
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: ZC (Corn) via reference_futures + futures_continuation ---
# market_data_source() does not expose carry/spread outputs.
# Loading ZC via reference_futures → futures_continuation mirrors the ZS path
# and ensures cont.carry and cont.spread are populated (not all-NaN).
zc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZC')()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zc_ref.o, zc_ref.h, zc_ref.l, zc_ref.c, zc_ref.v, zc_ref.oi, zc_ref.s)

zc = cont.c
zc_carry = cont.carry
zc_spread = cont.spread

# --- Reference: ZS (Soybeans) via futures_continuation ---
# reference_futures returns raw multi-contract data (List columns).
# Must pipe through futures_continuation for proper front-month close.
# spread_depth=1 added to capture ZS carry (M1/M2 - 1) for regime analysis.
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)
zs = zs_cont.c
zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# --- C/S Ratio ---
ratio = zc / zs
ratio_ma20 = ma(period=20)(ratio)

# --- Calendar month extraction ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Seasonal norm: expanding mean per calendar month ---
is_jan = month_num == 1
is_feb = month_num == 2
is_mar = month_num == 3
is_apr = month_num == 4
is_may = month_num == 5
is_jun = month_num == 6
is_jul = month_num == 7
is_aug = month_num == 8
is_sep = month_num == 9
is_oct = month_num == 10
is_nov = month_num == 11
is_dec = month_num == 12

jan_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jan, ratio)))
feb_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_feb, ratio)))
mar_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_mar, ratio)))
apr_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_apr, ratio)))
may_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_may, ratio)))
jun_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jun, ratio)))
jul_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jul, ratio)))
aug_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_aug, ratio)))
sep_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_sep, ratio)))
oct_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_oct, ratio)))
nov_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_nov, ratio)))
dec_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_dec, ratio)))

seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_jan, jan_avg,
    is_feb, feb_avg,
    is_mar, mar_avg,
    is_apr, apr_avg,
    is_may, may_avg,
    is_jun, jun_avg,
    is_jul, jul_avg,
    is_aug, aug_avg,
    is_sep, sep_avg,
    is_oct, oct_avg,
    is_nov, nov_avg,
    dec_avg
)

seasonal_dev = (ratio - seasonal_norm) / seasonal_norm

# --- Carry MA ---
carry_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zc_carry)
zs_carry_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zs_carry)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME ANALYSIS (Backwardation = carry > 0)
# =============================================================================

# Regime flags: 1 = backwardation, 0 = contango
zc_back_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry > 0) else 0.0
zs_back_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_carry) and zs_carry > 0) else 0.0

# For shaded band overlays on carry chart (non-zero = band on)
zc_back_band = where(zc_carry > 0, 1.0)
zs_back_band = where(zs_carry > 0, 1.0)

# Year extraction for frequency bar chart
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)

# Forward carry: level of carry 63 bars ahead (~1 quarter)
# Tests whether today's regime predicts next quarter's roll yield
zc_carry_fwd63 = zc_carry << 63
zs_carry_fwd63 = zs_carry << 63

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table
# Uses AggType.Max/Min/Last — no hardcoded period windows
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Corn/Soybean Ratio & Term Structure',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['C/S Ratio', 'Seasonal', 'Term Structure'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'High', 'Low'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Ratio', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period High', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period Low', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Seasonal Norm', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Seasonal Dev', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='20d MA', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Carry (M1/M2)', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Spread (M1-M2)', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Carry 20d MA', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot'
)(ratio, ratio, ratio, seasonal_norm, seasonal_dev, ratio_ma20, zc_carry, zc_spread, carry_ma20)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: C/S Ratio with MA & Seasonal Norm
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn/Soybean Ratio (NoAdjustment)',
    category='2. C/S Ratio',
    y_axis_label='C/S Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='C/S Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Norm', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio, ratio_ma20, seasonal_norm))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Carry Signal (Term Structure)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn Carry: Front/Back - 1 (Backwardation > 0, Contango < 0)',
    category='3. Term Structure',
    y_axis_label='Carry',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry 20d MA', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_carry, carry_ma20))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Calendar Spread M1-M2
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn Calendar Spread: M1 - M2 (spread_depth=1)',
    category='3. Term Structure',
    y_axis_label='Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='M1 - M2 Spread', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_spread,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 5: Monthly Seasonal Bar — Ratio by Calendar Month
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='C/S Ratio Seasonal Average by Month',
    category='2. C/S Ratio',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg C/S Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    order=4
)(values=ratio, label=month_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 6: Carry Time Series with Backwardation Shading
# ZC and ZS carry overlaid; shaded band highlights backwardation periods.
# is_band=True on the flag series renders it as a background shaded region.
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='ZC & ZS Carry with Backwardation Regime (Shaded)',
    category='4. Regime',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZC Carry', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZS Carry', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZC Backwardation', color=Color.Sky, is_band=True, area=True)
    ]),
    order=5
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_carry, zs_carry, zc_back_band))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 7: Backwardation Frequency by Year
# % of trading days each year where carry > 0 (backwardation).
# Mean aggregation on 0/1 flag = hit rate per year category.
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='% Days in Backwardation by Year (ZC vs ZS)',
    category='4. Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Year',
    y_axis_label='% Days in Backwardation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Exact,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ]),
    order=6
)(values=(zc_back_flag, zs_back_flag), label=year_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 8: Scatter — Current Carry vs Forward 63d Carry
# Does today's carry level predict next quarter's roll yield?
# Each point = one trading day. Positive slope = regime persistence.
# =============================================================================
xy_scatter(
    title='Does Carry Predict Next Quarter Roll Yield? (ZC)',
    category='4. Regime',
    x_axis_label='Current ZC Carry',
    y_axis_label='ZC Carry in 63 Days',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=4,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero', vertical=True)
    ]),
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='ZC: Carry → Fwd 63d', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='ZS: Carry → Fwd 63d', color=Color.Orange, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=7
)(x=zc_carry, y_values=(zc_carry_fwd63, zs_carry_fwd63))

# =============================================================================
# HIGH-CARRY BACKWARDATION ANALYSIS (ZC carry > 5%)
# =============================================================================
#
# forward_returns(period=63)(zc) = (zc[t+63] - zc[t]) / zc[t]
#   Safe on price series. NOT used on carry (division by ~0 → inf).
#
# Carry buckets (decimal):
#   Strong backwardation : carry > 0.05  (>5%)
#   Mild backwardation   : 0.02 < carry <= 0.05  (2-5%)
#   Weak backwardation   : 0.00 < carry <= 0.02  (0-2%)
#   Contango             : carry <= 0.00
# =============================================================================

# 63-day forward price return on ZC front-month close
zc_fwd_ret63 = forward_returns(period=63)(zc)

# Filter: only days where ZC carry > 5% (strong backwardation)
zc_high_carry_ret = where(zc_carry > 0.05, zc_fwd_ret63)

# Carry bucket flags for bar chart comparison
# Each flag = 1.0 on qualifying days, NaN otherwise → Mean agg = avg return in bucket
zc_ret_strong_back = where(zc_carry > 0.05, zc_fwd_ret63)
zc_ret_mild_back   = where(is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry > 0.02 and zc_carry <= 0.05, zc_fwd_ret63)
zc_ret_weak_back   = where(is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry > 0.0 and zc_carry <= 0.02, zc_fwd_ret63)
zc_ret_contango    = where(is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry <= 0.0, zc_fwd_ret63)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 9: Scatter — High-Carry Days: ZC Carry vs 63d Forward Price Return
# Each point = one day where carry > 5%. Slope shows whether stronger
# backwardation predicts better next-quarter price performance.
# =============================================================================
xy_scatter(
    title='High-Carry Backwardation (>5%): ZC Carry vs 63d Forward Return',
    category='5. High-Carry Regime',
    x_axis_label='ZC Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_label='63d Forward Price Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero Return'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='5% Carry', vertical=True)
    ]),
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='ZC High-Carry Days', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=8
)(x=zc_high_carry_ret, y_values=(zc_high_carry_ret,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 10: Bar Chart — Avg 63d Forward Return by Carry Bucket
# Compares next-quarter price performance across four carry regimes.
# Strong backwardation vs mild vs weak vs contango — is the premium monotonic?
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='ZC: Avg 63d Forward Return by Carry Regime',
    category='5. High-Carry Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Strong Back (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Mild Back (2-5%)', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Weak Back (0-2%)', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango (<0%)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    order=9
)(values=(zc_ret_strong_back, zc_ret_mild_back, zc_ret_weak_back, zc_ret_contango))
